description: This file implements a manager for WiFi configuration persistence via IARM and D-Bus utilities, including functions to retrieve current WiFi connection details, save settings asynchronously, and clear stored WiFi credentials.

classes.name: NetworkManagerMfrManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing WiFi credentials storage and retrieval via IARM and D-Bus utilities.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkManagerMfrManager.

methods.name: ~NetworkManagerMfrManager
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up IARM connection.

methods.name: saveWiFiSettingsToMfr
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves current WiFi details and saves them to Mfr via a background thread.

methods.name: saveWiFiSettingsToMfrSync
methods.description: Synchronously saves specified WiFi credentials to Mfr via IARM calls.

methods.name: clearWiFiSettingsFromMfr
methods.description: Clears stored WiFi credentials from Mfr via IARM.
